name: fens-demo-shop
description: Small demo storefront used as the FlowLens test target

scripts.dev: npm run build:server && SHOP_DEV=1 SHOP_VERSION=v1 PORT=5174 node dist-server/server/index.js
scripts.dev:v2: npm run build:server && SHOP_DEV=1 SHOP_VERSION=v2 PORT=5175 node dist-server/server/index.js
scripts.serve:v1: npm run typecheck && npm run build:client:v1 && npm run build:server && SHOP_VERSION=v1 PORT=5174 node dist-server/server/index.js
scripts.serve:v2: npm run typecheck && npm run build:client:v2 && npm run build:server && SHOP_VERSION=v2 PORT=5175 node dist-server/server/index.js
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:client:v1 && npm run build:client:v2 && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client:v1: SHOP_VERSION=v1 vite build --outDir dist/v1 --emptyOutDir && SHOP_VERSION=v1 vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist/ssr-v1 --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:client:v2: SHOP_VERSION=v2 vite build --outDir dist/v2 --emptyOutDir && SHOP_VERSION=v2 vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist/ssr-v2 --emptyOutDir
